title: billing-cluster-3 down — invoice generation timeout
description: Invoice generation jobs are timing out across the board since 14:00 UTC. The invoice service cannot connect to billing-cluster-3 which is unresponsive. Bulk invoice runs for enterprise customers are failing. Finance team is manually tracking affected invoices. Cluster restart attempts have not succeeded.

title: Charge API HTTP 500 — billing-cluster-3 outage
description: The /api/billing/charge endpoint is throwing HTTP 500 errors for all requests. Tracing shows requests routing to billing-cluster-3 are failing at the cluster layer. The cluster is in a failed state. Payment processing is completely broken for the affected routing group. Customer churn risk is high.

title: Settlement worker crash loop — billing-cluster-3 unreachable
description: Settlement workers are stuck in a crash loop because billing-cluster-3 is unreachable. The workers attempt to write settlement records, fail with connection timeout, and restart — repeating indefinitely. This is the same cluster as the invoice timeout and charge API failures. Shared root cause confirmed by Platform team.

title: Duplicate invoice complaint — customer received two invoices
description: Customer account #ACC-78234 reports receiving two identical invoices for the same subscription renewal. This appears to be a billing logic bug in the deduplication layer, not related to cluster health. The customer is requesting a credit for the duplicate charge. Finance team needs to investigate the dedup logic.

title: Billing documentation update — new proration policy
description: The billing team has updated the proration policy for mid-cycle plan changes. The internal documentation and the customer-facing FAQ need to be updated to reflect the new calculation method. Please coordinate with the docs team to publish the updates before the next billing cycle starts.
